description: Reviewed P/Invoke exports that the native-return scanner flags as high-confidence unclassified status candidates but that intentionally keep the safe raw-integer default for now. `scan_native_return_classification.py --check --baseline <this file>` passes when every flagged candidate is listed under `accepted`, so the gate ratchets only on NEW unclassified status-convention exports that appear after a future metadata regeneration. Triaged 2026-05-22.

not_a_direct_status_api.reason: Returns a value, not a Win32/WSA error code. A checked Result wrapper would be wrong; the raw integer return is correct.

names.inet_addr: packed IN_ADDR value with INADDR_NONE sentinel, not an error code
names.__WSAFDIsSet: FD_ISSET predicate; nonzero means the socket is in the set

watchlist_unproven_success_values.reason: DWORD/ULONG return from a direct-status-convention DLL; very likely ERROR_SUCCESS=success, but no documented success-value set exists, so collapsing to Result<Unit> risks rejecting an undocumented non-error status. Kept raw (safe default) pending documented success values or a runtime probe.

names.WinHttpQueryConnectionGroup: doc page exists but has no Return value section; synchronous, internally-allocated ppResult (no buffer-too-small path)
names.WinHttpProtocolSend: no public doc; async protocol-handle send, plausible ERROR_IO_PENDING success
names.WinHttpProtocolReceive: no public doc; async protocol-handle receive, plausible ERROR_IO_PENDING / buffer statuses
names.HttpGetExtension: no dedicated doc; HTTP Server direct error convention, but Buffer/BufferSize out path makes 122/234 plausible
names.DnsConnectionGetNameList: DWORD return; output struct internally allocated and freed via DnsConnectionFreeNameList; Set/Delete siblings already classified Unit
names.DnsConnectionGetProxyInfo: DWORD return; output freed via DnsConnectionFreeProxyInfo; sibling DnsConnectionSetProxyInfo classified Unit
names.DnsConnectionGetProxyList: DWORD return; output freed via DnsConnectionFreeProxyList
names.DnsConnectionGetProxyInfoForHostUrl: DWORD return; DNS_CONNECTION_PROXY_INFO_EX out, no caller buffer size
names.DnsConnectionGetProxyInfoForHostUrlEx: DWORD return; DNS_CONNECTION_PROXY_INFO_EX out, no caller buffer size
